decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=WRITE, dst=/sensor/temp, src=<zero-length PATH>, payload=VALUE u32=1234 } — the unacknowledged write (RFC-0004 Amendment 2): the terminus applies it and emits no frame, on success, refusal and denial alike.
decoded.note: The src child is present and empty, never omitted (the child run is positional). See description.md.
